Nodes.Speaker: $npc
Nodes.Text: Looks like you're already running a full crew. Come find me if a spot opens up.

Nodes.Speaker: $npc
Nodes.Text: Hey! You look like you're headed somewhere more interesting than this dock. Can I join up with you?

Nodes.Speaker: $npc
Nodes.Text: You won't regret it. Lead the way, boss!

Nodes.Speaker: $npc
Nodes.Text: Suit yourself. I'll be right here if you change your mind.
